log_level.description: Global log level: NONE, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE

plugin_paths.description: Colon-separated list of additional plugin directories

term_color.description: Terminal color mode: AUTO, NEVER, ALWAYS

lib_log_level.description: Override library log level: NONE, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE (empty = no override)

cli_log_level.description: Override CLI log level: NONE, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE (empty = no override)

py_log_level.description: Override Python bindings log level: NONE, FATAL, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE (empty = no override)

disable_dlclose.description: Leave dynamically loaded plugins open at exit (useful for debugging)

plugin_provider_dir.description: Override system plugin provider directory (empty = use default)

exec_on_abort.description: Command line to execute on unexpected abort (shell-parsed words)

bright_means_bold.description: Set to false to use SGR codes 90–97 (bright) instead of bold (1) + base colors

suppress_clash_warning.description: Suppress warning when trace path matches a babeltrace2 command name

legacy_debug.description: Enable legacy debug (equivalent to BABELTRACE_DEBUG=1 / TRACE log level)

legacy_verbose.description: Enable legacy verbose (equivalent to BABELTRACE_VERBOSE=1 / INFO log level)
